page: Amazon Web Services i7i.16xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8559C processors. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 64 virtual CPUs (32 physical cores with hyper-threading) running at 3.2 GHz. The CPU architecture includes a 320 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and 8-bit integer operations. The hardware configuration is equipped with 512.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

For high-throughput storage requirements, the i7i.16xlarge includes 15,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. This massive storage capacity is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 38 Gbps, managed via the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark evaluations, the i7i.16xlarge demonstrates strong multi-core CPU performance and top-tier Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks show strong performance, as do database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput. The hardware's support for AMX instructions enables strong prompt processing and text generation speeds for small and medium language models, though performance drops to average for large 70B model text generation. This profile makes the instance highly suitable for large-scale databases, high-throughput storage workloads, data compilation, and localized machine learning inference.
description: Amazon Web Services i7i.16xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance designed for data-intensive workloads. It features 64 vCPUs (32 physical cores) powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor running at 3.2 GHz, alongside 512.0 GB of DDR5 memory. The instance is equipped with 15,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 38 Gbps, running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. Benchmark results indicate top-tier Geekbench scores, strong multi-core performance, and strong database and memory bandwidth capabilities. The CPU supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel AMX, which assist in cryptographic, mathematical, and machine learning inference tasks. This server is optimized for high-capacity database operations, static web serving, and memory-intensive applications requiring massive local storage.
